result.summary: Round 3, lens market: wrote runs/WF06-20260925-01/response-market.json (sai.idea-response/1) with 2 responses, one per disagreement raised against my scores. (1) raised_by execution, 02-sai competition_gap: revise 4 -> 3. (2) raised_by owner_fit, 02-sai competition_gap: revise 4 -> 3 (same `to` value). I checked their evidence against the cleaned copies and both points hold. 02 has no dated market-check section, unlike 03 and 04. Its 'Что нашли' row in 05 lists only problem facts, while the neighbouring clothing rows list competitors. The 05 quote I had used as corroboration comes from the AR try-on row, not from a search for size-recommendation vendors. So my 4 rested on the idea's own unverified claim, the kind of label I refused to credit for 01. The try-on can be bought as an API, so the barrier to entry is low. Final market scores for 02-sai: demand_evidence 3, competition_gap 3.
